notes.title: Monthly update plan
notes.content:
Dear players, hello! Today, we bring you the update plan for "Inkighter"!

Version V0.1.0.0 will be updated in mid to late August and will include the following content:

English Localization Update: After the update, the game will fully support English localization, including interface and subtitles.
Arcade Mode: A new game mode will be available for everyone to challenge.
Training Mode: In this mode, you can choose the playable characters you want to practice with and select training opponents to practice moves and tactics.
New Playable Characters: Players will be able to experience two playable enemy characters currently under testing in the upcoming Training Mode!
Visual Upgrades: We will implement extensive visuals and effect updates to give the game a whole new visual experience!
Bug Fixes: Several known issues will be fixed.

Additionally, the V0.2.0.0 version is expected to be updated in mid-September and is expected to include the following content:

Japanese Localization
Local Multiplayer Mode
PVP Mode
Visual Updates
Thank you for your patience, and please continue to support "Inkighter"!

notes.title: V0.0.1.2 Release Note
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that "Duguang Danqing Lu" is now officially available to everyone!
However, there are still some issues in the initial release that we plan to address and fix in the coming updates.
The localization for English, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese is not yet complete. We will prioritize the localization work for these languages and release the updated versions as soon as possible. We kindly ask players who wish to use these languages to be patient.
The trophy achievement system is currently in development, and more achievements will be available soon!
We hope everyone will actively help us by providing feedback to assist us in identifying and fixing bugs, thereby enhancing the overall gaming experience.

Thank you for your understanding and support. Please continue to support "Inkighter"!

notes.title: "INKIGHTER"Released Today
notes.content:
[b]Explore the Vast World of Duguang and Unveil the Secrets of Mountains and Seas – "INKIGHTER" is Coming Soon. Join the Epic Battle Journey Now![/b]

"INKIGHTER" is a game that blends action combat and strategic exploration. Players will explore unknown realms on a vast continent, face powerful beasts, and unlock endless challenges. Key features include:

- Frame-by-Frame Ink Art: Experience the visual thrill of frame-by-frame animation in a world built with ink art.
- Strategic Free Exploration: Freely explore the expansive world of Duguang, uncover hidden secrets and legends.
- All-New Combat System: Enjoy a smooth and challenging action combat experience, pitting yourself against formidable enemies.
- Deep Character Design: Characters with entirely different combat feels and controls, offering distinct experiences.

In the game, you will feel the thrill of intense battles, immerse yourself in a profound and moving story, and gain endless fun through exploration and puzzle-solving.

[b]"INKIGHTER" will launch on Steam on July 16, 2024, with a 15% off introductory sale![/b]

notes.title: 《都广丹青录》正在参与「东方游戏文化周」活动！
notes.content:
Hi 大家好，

《都广丹青录》很高兴的宣布，我们正在参与由蒸汽平台主办的「东方游戏文化周」活动！

在「东方游戏文化周」活动期间，将配合本次活动推出《都广丹青录Demo》，提供广大玩家进行免费试玩体验。

《都广丹青录Demo》是Joytoart Gaming第一作独立游戏，选择了以中国传统神话故事为题材所创作，采用经典的2D+Z轴视角以及水墨风格进行的帧动画制作，游戏核心有着格斗类型的招式判定和规则，配合充满想象力的世界观和特色小游戏，有着不同于同类游戏独一品的游戏体验。玩家将扮演传说中的后裔们，在八荒地界中进行探索和冒险。此Demo版本仅提供部分试玩内容，更多内容请期待正式版本。


《都广丹青录》期待在「东方游戏文化周」活动与各位热爱游戏的鉴赏家们相遇。
「东方游戏文化周」游戏展活动：https://store.steampowered.com/sale/easterngamesfest
